description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It provides a sample launcher activity that displays a grid of sample items, allowing users to select and navigate to different sections of the app. The class includes an internal Sample class representing each sample item, an adapter for populating the grid view, and event handling for item clicks.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a grid of sample options for navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures the grid view with sample items.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles item click events in the grid, launching the associated activity.
